children: Motorola Solutions increased its share repurchase authorization by $2.0 billion, bringing the total repurchase program to $20 billion with no expiration.
Board approved $2.0 billion increase to the share repurchase program, raising total authorization to $20 billion.
Program has no expiration date, allowing ongoing repurchases subject to market conditions.
Through July 4, 2026, the company had repurchased about $17.4 billion under the program.
Repurchases may occur in the open market or via privately negotiated transactions.
